response.overview: Operation 1: Curious Fruit- Ai sees... them. Curious. Excited. VERY turned on. And then they're gone. But for reasons she doesn't understand she has to follow, and her journey takes her to a place she never knew (both physically and emotionally). Discovering something smoldering deep within her very being, she leaves her old self and becomes what she was always destined to be... Admired. Scorned. Worshiped. Abused...  Operation 2: Sacred Girl- To his sister he's always been much closer than to anyone else... even his parents when they were alive. His sister almost realizes this. He realizes it only too well. He is alone... except for when he's in the nerve center of his domain. From this hidden room, he experiences adults playing and everything else by proxy... courtesy of many concealed video cameras. Life is only real to him when he sees it on a monitor, and on most of those monitors is his sister...
